title: CPU parallelism determinism property test suite
description:
## Goal

Property-test harness that asserts the byte-identity contract from
Phase 0 design doc §11 across worker counts {1, 2, 4, 8, 24} for at
least three (rate, modulation) configurations. Also lands the
CLAUDE.md amendments documenting the Phase A deliverables.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc: `dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md`
§11 (determinism contract). Wave A.4: depends on `db9836e4` (channels)
and `5f12e7ff` (heartbeat — to test resume-vs-uninterrupted parity).

This is the Phase A closing task: lands the property-test suite +
the CLAUDE.md amendments that close Story `bcf7776d`'s `[hard]`
documentation criterion. Per the project plan §7 and Q5 decision,
CLAUDE.md updates fold into the closing task of each phase rather
than living as standalone tasks.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/tests/determinism.rs` containing:
   - For each of (r1/2 16-QAM, r2/3 64-QAM, r3/4 16-QAM), for each
     worker count in {1, 2, 4, 8, 24}:
     - Run a 200-frame batch at a fixed seed and a fixed Es/N0 near
       the smoke-knee.
     - Collect `(fer, frames, errors, mean_iters)`.
     - Assert byte-identity against the 1-worker reference for the
       four columns.
     - Assert BER is **excluded** from byte-identity (the test
       records but does not assert it).
   - For each (rate, modulation): one heartbeat-resume parity case
     where the SIGINT happens at frame 100; resume produces the
     same final tuple as an uninterrupted 200-frame run.
2. The tests use a `seeded_runner_factory()` helper that constructs
   a `Pipeline` from the typestate preset (`81d05bab`) so the
   property test exercises the production code path, not a stripped
   helper.
3. CLAUDE.md amendments (Phase A close):
   - Add `gf2-sim` module map to the "Architecture" section per
     project plan §7 line "After Phase A".
   - Add the determinism contract paragraph (cite Phase 0
     design-doc §11 verbatim; do not paraphrase per memory rule
     `feedback_quote_ssot_formulas_verbatim`).
   - Note `parallelism-pays` gate in the gates section.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Property test passes byte-identity for `fer / frames /
  errors / mean_iters` across worker counts {1, 2, 4, 8, 24} for
  the three named (rate, modulation) configurations.
- [hard] Heartbeat-resume parity case passes for each of the three
  configurations.
- [hard] BER is explicitly excluded from byte-identity in the
  assert (a comment cites the status-quo amendment from issue
  `152388f4` and design-doc §11).
- [hard] CLAUDE.md updated with the three items above; the
  determinism-contract paragraph is verbatim from design-doc §11.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review`, `tests` gates green.

## Non-goals

- GPU determinism tests (owned by Phase B `14f59c2d`).
- Performance regression checks (handled in `parallelism-pays`
  receipts, not this test suite).
